text:
Alex: Heads up — PR #8241 fixes a leak in the Zipkin tracing path that caused worker mem to grow under heavy load. Need 2x LGTM before today's release cutoff (20:00 UTC). Can someone take a quick look? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/8241

Maya: @Alex putting eyes now. quick question — does this change the trace payload shape?

Alex: No, payloads unchanged. Just guards around span buffering + frees a buffer earlier. Kept compatibility test in suite.

Nate: I'll run a smoke (light load) in staging. ETA ~15m.

Sam: If staging perf looks good I can give a +1. Who will own merge if we hit the cutoff?

Lina: I can merge and roll forward canary. ping me when both LGTM.

Nate: smoke run done: no regressions, mem growth plateaued. command I used: ./scripts/smoke_test --filter zipkin --duration 8m

Maya: Reviewed diffs, left one nit but not blocking. LGTM.

Sam: Quick local run OK. LGTM :thumbsup:

Alex: Thanks, @Maya @Sam. @Lina ready for merge.

release-bot: deploy-checklist: canary-health OK, e2e queued, estimated merge safe window 18m before cutoff.

Lina: Merging now, will watch canary for 10m. If everything stays green I'll promote. :rocket:

Alex: Appreciated — leaving monitoring on. If any regression I'll revert and open follow-up.
